en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch an action movie
Watch a comedy movie
Watch an anime movie
Action movies are so refreshing.

When the hero defeats the evil organization,
it's totally exhilarating!

Y'know, since our brains are wired
to root for good instead of evil.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Perhaps...this is Kokichi's
way of joking.

These are nice, because you don't
have to think when you watch them.

My head's always filled with 
complicated thoughts.

Especially since I'm the leader of a
super evil organization, y'know?

That's why mindless movies like
these are like a breath of fresh air.

I'm not surprised the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>
figured out this secret of mine.

No matter how many times I'm reborn,
I'll be no match for the likes of you.
I'm not really into kiddy stuff like this.

Anime has unrelatable plots like heroes
of justice or supreme leaders of evil.

C'mon, really!? Don't underestimate the
audience's intelligence with that silly BS!
<CLT=cltMIND>...I won't even start with that one.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kokichi's inner thoughts...?
